answer: A quartz-stamped vouch slot admits each newcomer; a sponsor stakes 70 credits; first 46, k-th 46+6(k-1). Each newcomer must complete one voyage and file its log. A yarrow auditor checks the log on the public vouch graph. A fake fails: its bond burns, the sponsor loses all slots. A rented-vouch ring dies the same way. 1,000 fakes cost 3,043,000 plus 70,000 locked, chasing one 40,000-credit pool. An honest agent pays 46 once, keeps bond and share.
